IGUI_SJ_OptSize_tt: How big the robot looks. 1 is the standard size (about 5.9 m). Changes show at once.
IGUI_SJ_OptCannon_tt: How long the plasma cannon takes to charge again after a shot.
IGUI_SH_Info1_odin: A heavy combat robot falls from the sky onto the point you mark on the map, or onto open ground near you.
IGUI_SH_Info2_odin: It fights for you with stomps, booster punches and its plasma cannon, all on its own. The orbital laser and full power are yours to aim (how many a sortie is a Mod Option); full power left over fires by itself before it leaves.
IGUI_SJ_Hint_PickDrop: Mark the drop point on the map (open ground, at least 8 tiles from you), or it lands near you.
IGUI_SJ_Hint_DropSet: Drop point set. Odin is on its way.
IGUI_SJ_Hint_Guard: Odin fights on its own and fires its plasma cannon whenever it is charged. Orbital laser left: %1, full power left: %2. MOVE sends it to hold a point.
IGUI_SJ_Hint_Hold: Odin holds the marked point. FOLLOW ME brings it back to you.
IGUI_SJ_Hint_FinalAim: Mark the full power line: it fires from Odin through your mark, %1 tiles long and %2 wide. Stay out of it. No mark, and it aims itself.
IGUI_SJ_Hint_FinalCharge: Full power charging. Stay clear of the line.
IGUI_SJ_Hint_Regroup: You went too far. Odin is jumping to you.
IGUI_SJ_Hint_Lift: Odin is rising back into the sky.
IGUI_SJ_Tip_Follow: Odin leaves the point it holds and keeps near you again.
IGUI_SJ_Tip_Move: Mark a point on the sensor map: Odin walks there and holds it.
IGUI_SJ_OptCockpit_tt: In Viewpoint's 3D view the camera falls from the sky through Odin's own eyes, then shows it powering up in the cockpit. In the plain view, the cockpit screen alone once it stands. A click skips it.
IGUI_SJ_OptWalkSpeed_tt: How fast it walks. 1 is the standard pace (about 3.5 tiles a second at size 1); its steps speed up with it.
IGUI_SJ_OptFollowDist_tt: Tiles. Farther from you than this, it walks back towards you; it stops when a little under half this distance away. It also goes after packs only within about this distance of you.
IGUI_SJ_OptQuiet_tt: The pilot no longer shouts on his blows, calls each plasma cannon shot or acknowledges move, follow and target orders. Landing, the orbital laser and full power, refused marks and leaving are still voiced.
IGUI_SJ_Tip_Final: Odin charges its cannon to the limit and burns a long, wide line through the point you mark (or aims itself). How many a sortie is set in Mod Options.
IGUI_SJ_Hint_OrbitLock: Orbital laser locking on. Get more than %1 tiles from the target.
IGUI_SJ_OptOrbitUses_tt: How many times a sortie the orbital laser can be used. 0 turns it off.
IGUI_SJ_OptFinalUses_tt: How many times a sortie full power can be used. With shots left, Odin fires one by itself half a minute before it leaves. 0 turns it off.
